mapper.sql: c.*, case when s.default_config_id = c.config_id then true else false end as is_default
mapper.select: select from dating_matchmaker_config c cross join dating_matchmaker_config_state s where s.state_id = 1 and c.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') order by is_default desc, c.config_id desc
select from dating_matchmaker_config c join dating_matchmaker_config_state s on s.default_config_id = c.config_id and s.state_id = 1
select from dating_matchmaker_config c cross join dating_matchmaker_config_state s where s.state_id = 1 and c.config_id = #{id}
select default_config_id from dating_matchmaker_config_state where state_id = 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into dating_matchmaker_config (name, watermark_text, min_age, max_age, min_height, max_height, required_fields, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{name}, #{watermarkText}, #{minAge}, #{maxAge}, #{minHeight}, #{maxHeight}, #{requiredFieldsJson}, 1, #{createBy}, current_timestamp, #{createBy}, current_timestamp)
mapper.update: update dating_matchmaker_config set name=#{name}, watermark_text=#{watermarkText}, min_age=#{minAge}, max_age=#{maxAge}, min_height=#{minHeight}, max_height=#{maxHeight}, required_fields=#{requiredFieldsJson}, version=version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=current_timestamp where config_id=#{configId} and version=#{version}
update dating_matchmaker_config_state set default_config_id=#{id}, update_by=#{actor}, update_time=current_timestamp where state_id=1
